question: Which folk dance of Ladakh is performed in Leh and is preceded by a horse race?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Koshan**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Koshan** is a traditional folk dance of **Ladakh**, performed predominantly in the **Leh region**. 
• This dance is often preceded by a **horse race**, which is an integral part of the event and adds a festive atmosphere to the celebration. 
• The dance is known for its **vibrant and energetic movements**, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Ladakh. 
• It is typically performed during significant festivals and celebrations, showcasing the **unity and joy** of the local community.
